requirements.requirement: The system must invoke the deterministic provider scoring engine from evaluate_care_facade when provider detail data is requested.
The system must pass all required provider quality measures (≥3) from the provider detail payload into the scoring engine.
The system must return a composite provider score in the facade response alongside existing provider detail fields without removing any existing fields.
The system must ensure that identical provider inputs produce identical composite scores via the facade (deterministic behavior).
The system must include component measure values used for scoring in the facade response structure if available from upstream data.
The system must not call the scoring engine if fewer than 3 valid quality measures are present and must return a null or absent score field.
The system must handle scoring engine exceptions by returning provider details without a score and logging the failure.
The system must ensure that scoring execution does not increase facade response latency beyond acceptable service thresholds defined for EvaluateCare.
The system must structure the composite score in a consistent schema compatible with downstream API response models.
The system must ensure the scoring integration does not mutate original provider input data within the facade.
The system must expose scoring output in a format that an LLM can consume without additional transformation (structured, labeled fields).
The system must ensure the composite score field is numerically normalized to a consistent range suitable for LLM comparison across providers.
The system must include explicit field names for score and component measures that are semantically clear to an LLM (e.g., 'composite_score','measure_scores').
The system must ensure that absence of a score is explicitly represented (null or missing field) so an LLM does not infer a value.
The system must ensure scoring outputs are consistent across repeated facade calls to prevent LLM hallucination due to inconsistent data.
The system must include measure-level detail sufficient for an LLM to explain the score without requiring access to the scoring algorithm internals.
The system must avoid embedding any non-deterministic or free-text generated content within the scoring fields returned by the facade.
The system must ensure that scoring fields are always present in the response schema contract even if values are null to maintain LLM parsing stability.
